title: Nice Throw (Wii Sports)
blurb: Wii Sports bowling shipped with an announcer who has never once been discouraging, and this is his signature move. He says it whether you struck, spared, or sent the ball into the gutter with a movement that also unplugged the television — the man simply believes in you. That unconditional support is why the clip has survived as a meme: it is funniest when the result was objectively poor and the praise arrives anyway. Use it for genuine successes, or for the ironic joy of being congratulated on something that went badly wrong.
origin: The bowling announcer from Wii Sports (Nintendo, 2006).
